routes.serves: create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content + labels); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body

labels.name: Reminders
labels.description: Default label assigned during note creation (REQ-2.7.4). The label catalog (LABEL_CATALOG) is seeded with Reminders and every new note created from the Take a note editor is saved with the Reminders label.
Array of label names assigned to the note. POST /api/notes now accepts a labels array; when the body omits it, the created note defaults to ['Reminders'].

notes: REQ-2.7.4: assign the default "Reminders" label during note creation. The acceptance flow is: open composer -> More options -> Change labels -> check the Reminders checkbox -> fill title/content -> Close -> sidebar -> click Reminders -> created note visible. Implementation: (1) the composer gains a "More options" button that opens the same labels dialog used by note cards but in composer mode (pending labels stored in state.composerLabels, sent in the POST body); (2) POST /api/notes accepts and persists a labels array, defaulting to ['Reminders'] for a new note; (3) the static "Reminders" sidebar nav-item is removed so the REQ-2.7.3 label-filter "Reminders" button (bell icon) is the one clicked by the test — filtering by the label, not by reminder date. The label catalog already contains Reminders (REQ-2.7.3); the labels dialog checkbox carries the accessible name "Reminders" verbatim. db.json is seeded with the spec-mandated fixture notes for label filtering ('Call dentist existing' with the Reminders label, 'Design review' with the Work label, 'Movie list' unlabeled) so the REQ-2.7.6.x / REQ-3.1 tests keep passing.
